mapper.select: SELECT distinct t2.sec_acct_id id, t2.sec_acct_name text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO t INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT t1 on t1.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO t2 on t2.sec_acct_id = t1.acct_no WHERE t.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select portfolio_id, sec_acct_id ,finprod_id,actualPositionAmount from ( select portfolio_id, sec_acct_id ,finprod_id,actualPositionAmount from ( select portfolio_id, sec_acct_id, finprod_id, nvl(sum(case when hoding_type = '03' then AMOUNT end), 0)+ nvl(sum(case when hoding_type = '05' then AMOUNT end), 0) - nvl(sum(case when hoding_type = '06' then AMOUNT end), 0) actualPositionAmount from PTL_SEC_POSITION
where 1=1
and portfolio_id in (
#{prot,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
and cdate = to_date(#{cdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
#{secHodingType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by portfolio_id, sec_acct_id, finprod_id ) t
order by actualPositionAmount desc ) where rownum=1
